Title: Reliquiae Baxterianae: or, Mr. Richard Baxter's narrative of the most memorable passages of his life and times; faithfully publish'd from his own original manuscript by Matthew Sylvester
Creator: Richard Baxter (1615-1691); published by Matthew Sylvester (per the host)
Publisher: London: printed for T. Parkhurst, J. Robinson, J. Lawrence, and J. Dunton (per the host metadata; the imprint is not captured in the OCR)
Publication Date: 1696
Rights: Public Domain (published 1696, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item's own rights statement reads 'NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT')
Source: Internet Archive item reliquiaebaxteri00baxt (https://archive.org/details/reliquiaebaxteri00baxt), the item's own reliquiaebaxteri00baxt_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: University of California Libraries; host metadata date: 1696. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: 78b1385f083e834a4ad6d2583ae8ff12f6e019a35db9c73f5f7605c265b71af6.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. University of California Libraries scan of the folio; the first leaves are library stamps read as noise and the title page is not captured in the OCR. The text begins with Sylvester's preface to the reader; the long s is read as f and the double columns are mostly kept apart.
Content note: Baxter's own history of his life and times, published after his death from his manuscript: the Civil War and Interregnum, the Savoy Conference of 1661, the Act of Uniformity and the ejection of 1662, and the long persecution and toleration of Nonconformists to the 1680s, with many of his papers and letters; the census's 'other half of the Great Ejection story' told by its most influential minister.
